meta.index_base: 2020-02-01 = 100, seasonally adjusted by Indeed Hiring Lab
meta.scope_caveat: This is the ALL-postings index for the metro, not software-only. Indeed publishes a Software Development sector index at national level; a metro-by-sector cut is not published, so the city line is all-jobs demand and is labelled as such.
meta.aggregation_note: Monthly mean of daily values; 'days' records how many daily observations each month carries.
